title: A production platform needs an agreed service scope, repeatable delivery, enforceable controls, and an adoption path
service_scope_heading: Define the service scope and ownership
adoption_heading: Prepare teams to adopt the service
service_scope_activities: Identify the initial users, workloads, and business outcomes the service must support
Document where the platform complements existing analytics and enterprise services
Assign central service responsibilities and the obligations of consuming teams
architecture_activities: Specify approved environment and workspace patterns
Set capacity, lifecycle, and promotion rules for each environment
Define integration, sharing, and workload placement criteria
delivery_activities: Create repeatable build and release workflows
Instrument monitoring, alerts, and service health checks
governance_activities: Apply identity, classification, lineage, and access policies
Define support coverage, service targets, cost reporting, and funding responsibilities
adoption_activities: Design intake, onboarding, training, and operational handoff around the first users
Pilot self-service requests with clear approval gates
Publish runbooks, examples, and reusable onboarding materials
framing_statement: Plan architecture, delivery, controls, and adoption together. Each workstream should produce a reviewable operating decision before the service is opened to additional teams.
